{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify completed orders (status == 'completed')
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Print the number and values of internal test orders
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {len(internal_test_orders)}")
print(f"Values of internal test orders: {internal_test_orders['revenue_clean'].tolist()}")

# Exclude internal test orders from completed orders
valid_completed = completed_orders[~completed_orders.index.isin(internal_test_orders.index)]

# Compute total revenue from valid completed orders
total_revenue = valid_completed['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue"}
